title: Eight review findings in Home, the Lead and the teams fixed inside the uncommitted 0.168.0 work
request: Fix eight review findings (three high, five medium) and the cheap smaller ones; a failing test first for each, then a minimal fix; no new core version.
spec: dclab-core 0.168.0 (unreleased): OUTREACH narrowed, added to its CHANGELOG entry. dclab_rnd: the built chat's rules read an order to ask the teams only as an order; the built chat's model history filtered by card_visible; the answered card claims only what a step recorded; ML Engineering reads Data Science's confirmed outcome only; Home's send() sets thinking before the await and lets the Claude-only lane through; one shared Claude guard for the live scripts.
plan: Write the failing tests for all findings together (plan(), lead_route, history under sign-in, answered words, ML Engineering's outcome, the scripts' guard, the send() source).
Fix each finding in the smallest place, inside the uncommitted 0.168.0 work; add the core change to its CHANGELOG entry.
Run the affected tests, make web and its check, make core-wheel-check; write this record and make sft-dev.

decisions.decision: "X and then ask the teams" plans X (reads and splittable tools only) and then ask_teams with the person's whole words
decisions.why: dropping X lost what the person asked; the whole sentence gives the teams the context of "whether it works"

decisions.decision: A sentence before the order ("Customers are leaving. Please ask the teams …") is context, not a second task
decisions.why: only an order joined by and/then is a list of tasks; planning every prefix sentence would add stray reads (S8's "Who should Sales call…?")

decisions.decision: Negation is read in the order's clause, a first-person future in its sentence
decisions.why: "customers are not renewing, so please ask the teams" is an order; "I will send the file, then ask the lead" is the person's own plan

decisions.decision: The Claude guard reads the resolved tiers and the model/provider/endpoint settings, not ANTHROPIC_MODEL
decisions.why: the owner's .env keeps Claude's name for the product; it is used only when the provider is Anthropic, which the tiers then show; reading it would refuse every live run

decisions.decision: On 409 the page keeps thinking on
decisions.why: a 409 means a turn holds the draft; its last event clears the state

decisions.decision: The quote check is lead.quote_is_request, not a change to dclab_core.case.quote_ok
decisions.why: quote_ok serves every case quote (its two-word floor is right there); only a hand-over to the teams needs a real span

decisions.decision: A run that calls no model (--rules, --report) is not refused under a Claude setting: live models are turned off for it
decisions.why: the rule forbids Claude answering in a test; turning live models off (DCLAB_NO_LIVE_MODELS=1) makes that impossible without blocking the rules' measurement

change: dclab_core/team_work.py (OUTREACH), dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md (0.168.0 entry); dclab_rnd/draft/orchestrator.py (ASK_TEAMS, asks_the_teams, _plan_one, Orchestrator._readable/history, ask_teams quote); dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (_answer_teams words, _still_waiting once); dclab_rnd/teamspace/lead.py (answered_words, still_waiting_due, quote_is_request); dclab_rnd/teamspace/agents.py (FOUND, _contract_report); dclab_rnd/agents/case_agent.py (_ask_teams: quote, no draft refused); dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/home.html (send) and static/app via make web; scripts/no_claude.py (new), live_lead_scenarios.py, live_lead_teams.py; tests/test_lead_workspace.py, test_core_team_work.py, test_web_client.py. Round 2: dclab_rnd/draft/store.py (update), scripts/no_claude.py (thinking_record, refuse_claude(model_used)), tests/test_draft_store_processes.py.

findings.defect: "Don't ask the team" and "I will ask my team" went to the Lead; "Show the data and then ask the teams" dropped the data
findings.scenario: plan("Please don't ask the team, just show me the data") gave ask_teams
findings.cause: ASK_TEAMS matched anywhere; NO checked only the first word; ask_teams returned alone
findings.fix: an order only at a sentence's start or after please/and/then/can you, never after a negation in its clause or an "I will" in its sentence; X before "and then" is planned first

findings.defect: Ordinary questions about calls and phones went to Sales
findings.scenario: lead_route('model', 'Do phone service customers churn more?') added sales
findings.cause: "phone" and "calls" read as verbs, up to three words between verb and people, "who/which … will … call" accepted
findings.fix: phone and calls dropped as verbs; only the/our/these/those (and one word) between; should/shall/must required

findings.defect: One person's hidden Lead card reached another person's model
findings.scenario: a shared draft with sign-in on: Omar's built-chat history held Sara's "The teams ask:" card
findings.cause: Orchestrator.history read the messages without the route's _cards_for_reader filter
findings.fix: Orchestrator._readable drops messages lead.card_visible refuses for the current principal

findings.defect: The chat said the answer was given to the teams when Home's rules skipped it
findings.scenario: a second answer after the first: refused and steps both empty
findings.cause: the words keyed only on out['refused']
findings.fix: lead.answered_words claims it only when a step recorded team_record_human_response or team_answer; else says it was already answered

findings.scenario: the turn's final event cleared thinking before await DC.client.message returned; setThinking(true) then ran
findings.fix: setThinking(true) before the await, setThinking(false) on a failure other than 409

findings.defect: The Claude-only lane was blocked while DCLab answered
findings.scenario: S.thinking true, a message to Claude only: refused with the still-answering toast
findings.cause: the guard ran before the to === 'claude' branch, which takes no draft lock
findings.fix: guard moved below the Claude-only branch

findings.defect: ML Engineering could claim the person's own earlier outcome as confirmed with Data Science
findings.scenario: question text "…\nThe outcome is: a late payment." and Data Science confirmed "Cancellation of the subscription"
findings.cause: _CONFIRMED.search took the first "The outcome is:" in the whole question
findings.fix: search only after the last "\nData Science found: " the Lead added (agents.FOUND)

findings.defect: The live scripts could run on a Claude model and live_lead_teams kept no invented-tables mark or thinking check
findings.scenario: OPENROUTER_MODEL=anthropic/claude-… passed live_lead_scenarios' check; live_lead_teams had none
findings.cause: a check of DCLAB_LLM_PROVIDER only, in one script
findings.fix: scripts/no_claude.py: claude_settings/refuse_claude over the resolved tiers and the model settings, used by both scripts after .env; live_lead_teams marks invented tables and fails a call without thinking

findings.defect: "The teams' question still waits" was posted after every non-answer message
findings.scenario: two questions of the person's own while the teams' question waited: two cards
findings.cause: _still_waiting never looked at what the chat already said
findings.fix: lead.still_waiting_due: once per question of the teams

findings.defect: The lead agent's tool handed a request over with the draft id "draft"
findings.scenario: a case session without a Home conversation
findings.fix: refused: the teams answer in a Home conversation

findings.defect: A model's quote of any two of the person's words became the teams' request
findings.scenario: quote "rank the accounts" from "Do not rank the accounts yet. First explain …"
findings.cause: quote_ok's two-word floor, no negation check
findings.fix: lead.quote_is_request: one run of at least four words or 60% of the message, not after a negation; used by both hand-over tools

findings.defect: Reviewer round 2: after the R1 fix a comma no longer started an order
findings.scenario: "Yes, ask the teams", "OK, ask the teams", "Good idea, ask the teams to check the tables" planned []; "Sure, ask Data Science" planned show_data
findings.cause: the lead group listed sentence ends but not a comma
findings.fix: a comma starts an order too (the negation is read per clause, so it stays safe); an order taken back in the next sentence ("Ask the team? No, show me the data.") is not one

findings.defect: Reviewer round 2: the Claude guard refused legitimate Qwen runs
findings.scenario: DCLAB_BLOCK_PROVIDERS=openai,anthropic, or a tier on a blocked Anthropic endpoint, refused every run; --rules and --report, which call no model, were refused too
findings.cause: any setting with PROVIDER in its name and anthropic in its value was flagged; a blocked tier still named its provider
findings.fix: setting names with BLOCK and blocked endpoints skipped, blocked tiers skipped; refuse_claude(model_used=False) turns live models off instead of refusing

findings.defect: Reviewer round 2: one timeout or 429 failed a live run's thinking check
findings.scenario: an exchange kept with outcome "error: TimeoutError" has no thinking and was counted as a call without it
findings.fix: one shared thinking_record in scripts/no_claude.py counts only outcome "ok" exchanges and reports errored calls apart; both scripts use it

findings.defect: Reviewer round 2: a draft deleted between the folder check and the lock raised FileNotFoundError
findings.scenario: another process deletes the draft after is_dir() and before its .lock file is opened
findings.cause: only the folder check raised KeyError
findings.fix: opening the lock file's FileNotFoundError becomes KeyError (DraftStore.update)

measurements.result: 184 tests on files and 89 on PostgreSQL pass

outcome: The built chat's rules hand a request to the teams only when the person orders it, and keep the rest of the message; Sales is asked only about contacting people; another person's Lead cards stay out of the model's history; the chat claims what was done; the live scripts refuse a Claude model however it is configured. No live model was run.
lessons: A rule that reads orders must read them where orders are: at the start of a clause, and not under a negation. A filter on what a reader sees belongs on every path that reads the same messages, a model's history included.
A fix that narrows a pattern needs the old positives in its test: the first fix's own test list missed "Yes, ask the teams", which the old rule handed over.
risks: Words, not an understanding: an order phrased another way ("get the teams on this") stays in the chat; the live path's model was not rerun after these fixes.
